text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "Technically, the micro-district heating network is easy to realise.", "gist": "Micro-district heating networks are technically simple to implement."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "The idea, which originated in Basel, therefore has the potential to be used throughout Switzerland.", "gist": "The Basel-originated idea can be applied across Switzerland."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Network tariffs contribute to an efficient and secure electricity network.", "gist": "Network tariffs support an efficient and secure electricity network."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "In Switzerland, more and more electricity is being produced locally and fed into the electricity distribution network, for example from photovoltaic systems on buildings, while ever more consumers are drawing electricity from the distribution network, such as for electric vehicles and heat pumps.", "gist": "Switzerland sees increased local electricity production and consumption from sources like PV and EVs/heat pumps."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "This means that the distribution network is becoming increasingly overloaded.", "gist": "The electricity distribution network is becoming increasingly overloaded."}]}
